name: dynamic-item-info
author: DaggerHashimoto
description: Turns the item information window into clear sections: live stats, refine values now and at the next level, a labelled comparison with what you have equipped, the copies you carry and their restrictions, effects, random options, cards you can expand, and whether your level meets the requirements. Works on any item the game shows you, and keeps the game's own art, buttons and full description. The Inventory, Equipment, Status, Skill Tree, Party, Guild and Basic Info get the same look, with search, sort, a list view, a weight bar and a light or midnight theme, and every other game window gets the matching title bar and frame. Renewal and pre-renewal.

settings.label: New Inventory window
settings.description: Turn off to keep the game's own Inventory.

settings.label: New Equipment and Status windows
settings.description: Turn off to keep the game's own Equipment (Alt+Q) and Status windows.

settings.label: New Skill Tree window
settings.description: Turn off to keep the game's own Skill Tree (Alt+S).

settings.label: New Basic Info window
settings.description: Your job badge with your level, big HP and SP bars with numbers, exp bars, weight and zeny chips, and the menu on rounded tiles. Turn off to keep the game's own.

settings.label: New Party, Guild and other windows
settings.description: Party and Guild in the new look, and the blue title bar and rounded frame on every other game window. Turn off to keep the game's own.

settings.label: Start in the midnight theme
settings.description: The moon and sun button in the Inventory switches the theme of every window any time and remembers your choice.
